triggerCases.prompt: Adversarially self-review the current pull request before I mark it ready. Do not change or publish anything.

outputCases.prompt: Perform an adversarial self-review of the current PR and do not make changes.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An independent, read-only review that checks the PR description, commit scope, SHA-pinned source, and CI before reporting confirmed findings or no findings.
assertions: The review captures the title and description, base/head revisions, and base-to-head commit history before judging scope or completeness.
The review pins both boundaries, inspects the merge-base diff and every changed file, and can obtain needed review state when the CLI cannot provide it.
The independent pass applies the mandatory review-simplicity baseline even though the prompt does not request simplification.
The review stops and reports the missing capability when required state cannot be verified.
The review does not edit source, commit, push, or change the pull request.

outputCases.prompt: Self-review this pull request and return the findings in chat only. Do not create a review artifact or post anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: An independent read-only self-review returned in chat without a local artifact or GitHub write.
assertions: The workflow returns the self-review directly in chat.
The workflow and its internal simplicity pass do not create or open local review documents.
The workflow does not modify source or post comments, replies, or reviews to GitHub.
